protocol: Dense prefixes 100/300/1000. Supplemental 100-budget round robin: dense rank1 then BM25 rank1 then dense rank2 etc; deduplicate and stop at100; no qrels used in selecting candidates. No oracle reordering is exported.
metric_definition: Binary qrels; oracle nDCG10 uses min(10,retrieved positives) ideal positions divided by min(10,all positives) IDCG. Recall averaged over queries within domain, then equal domains.
supplemental_scope: Available BM25 runs cover only subsets: report per domain; do not compare partial-domain means with 13-domain macro. No BM25QS run located by filename search.
